verdict.rationale: OpenCode's enterprise docs say its centralized config can integrate with an organization's SSO provider for authentication and route all users through an internal AI gateway, so enterprise identity is a first-party capability. The documentation is a thin, two-sentence mention with no detail on how it is set up. The GitHub and OpenAI logins are personal subscription access, not enterprise identity, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: supported SSO protocols or identity providers (SAML/OIDC, Okta, Entra), cloud-platform identity auth (e.g. AWS/GCP/Azure IAM), setup documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability

citations.quote: Through the central config, OpenCode can integrate with your organization’s SSO provider for authentication.
This centralized config can integrate with your SSO provider and ensures all users access only your internal AI gateway.
